findings.description: WhatNow's report of Abanico Coffee Roasters' planned cafe opening at 424 Irving Street in the Inner Sunset; the same opening is carried in full by the Hoodline finding 2026-09-20-hl-0007.

citation.label: WhatNow San Francisco, “Abanico Coffee Roasters To Open On Irving Street In San Francisco,” 19 September 2026

raw.text: Abanico Coffee Roasters is preparing to open at 424 Irving St. in San Francisco, according to a social media announcement.

publish.note: One event, one entry. The same opening is published on the Irving Street page from Hoodline (2026-09-20-hl-0007), which carries the fuller account.

findings.description: Hadeem, a California-Jewish restaurant concept developed through years of pop-ups, is preparing to open a permanent location at 682 Haight Street in the Lower Haight in 2027, taking over the space currently occupied by Otra, a Mexican restaurant. The planned concept would serve coffee and babka by day, dinner and drinks in the evening, and weekend brunch, with a menu influenced by Jewish food traditions.

citation.label: WhatNow San Francisco, “Hadeem To Open In San Francisco’s Lower Haight,” 19 September 2026

raw.text: the restaurant is expected to open in 2027 at 682 Haight St.

findings.note: The chef/founder is a private individual and is not named per privacy rules.

publish.note: One event, one entry. /san-francisco/hayes-valley/haight-street/680/ already carries this opening from The San Francisco Standard, dated 2026-09-14 (news/items/sf-standard/2026-09-14.json, 2026-09-14-ss-0002), and the closure it displaces from Hoodline dated 2026-09-10.
